title: System Monitor — host telemetry dashboard
description: An Activity-Monitor-style dashboard: circular CPU/RAM/disk/GPU gauges, rolling CPU + network sparklines on glass panels, and a live process table — polling every 1.5s with a ~40-point history. The process list reflows by pane width: wide panes get a grid table, compact panes (≤440px container) get two-line touch cards. Telemetry is INJECTED via a small SysMonAdapter (stats/processes): point configureSysmon at a real host API (/proc, an agent, a cloud endpoint) or use the bundled wavy in-browser mock so it renders alive with zero backend. Self-contained: shell inspector hooks are inert seams in lib/host.ts; the only chrome dependencies are slice-local @container frame + touch-list shims.
